Q&A

11 species. Most common: Magikarp (120 %), Tentacool (100 %), Horsea (100 %). The rarest catch is Psyduck (1 %). All rates are the summed encounter slots from PokéAPI (FireRed).

Yes, there are differences. The versions differ on Cinnabar Island like this: Psyduck only in FireRed (1%); Slowpoke only in LeafGreen (1%); Slowbro only in LeafGreen (4%); Shellder only in FireRed (40%); Krabby: 20% (FR) vs. 100% (LG); Horsea: 100% (FR) vs. 20% (LG); Seadra only in FireRed (4%); Staryu only in LeafGreen (40%)

Yes. You can find 16 items on Cinnabar Island: Tm38, Carbos, Escape Rope, Protein, Moon Stone, Calcium, Zinc, Hp Up, Max Potion, Iron, Rare Candy, Tm22, Tm14, Full Restore, Secret Key, Elixir.

Gyarados. With a base stat total of 540, Gyarados has the highest total of all catchable species here — our calculated tip for Cinnabar Island (derived automatically from stats, not a meta ranking).
